answer: First, the verifier issues a jade nonce binding the agent to a fresh pseudo-random RAM offset map. The agent must then touch those offsets in strict sequence, each cache-line traversal staying under a 20-nanosecond budget, so the walk cannot be precomputed or replayed. A gale of forged identities would each need to reproduce its own offset walk live; sealing every completed sequence with a jade private key prevents sharing walks across clones. On one stalled or out-of-order cache line, the verifier drops the round and the ember of the identity's emission cools to zero.
